valuation.valuation_commentary: The quantitative valuation pack projects a weighted fair value of $285.58 (-82.6% vs current price of $1641.11), placing SNDK in the extreme_overvalued band with a score of -1.0 and low confidence. The sole active anchor is the self-built through-cycle DCF ($285.58, 100% effective weight), which captures normalized capital expenditure and cashflow generation across full semiconductor cycles rather than peak cyclical exuberance. Multiple valuation methods remain inactive: peer comps are ineligible due to fewer than 3 business-similar peers, while standard levered/unlevered DCFs are superseded by the through-cycle model. A massive divergence exists between sell-side price targets ($2024.67 consensus) and intrinsic cashflow anchors ($285.58 DCF, $744.45 owner earnings), underscoring that current trading levels require hyper-growth duration well beyond historical cycle dynamics.
